sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_ZRAM_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
DEVICE=/dev/zram0
case "${1:-start}" in
  start)
    /sbin/modprobe zram num_devices=1
    if grep -q "^${DEVICE} " /proc/swaps; then
      exit 0
    fi
    if [ "$(cat /sys/block/zram0/disksize)" != "0" ]; then
      echo 1 > /sys/block/zram0/reset
    fi
    echo 536870912 > /sys/block/zram0/disksize
    /sbin/mkswap "$DEVICE"
    /sbin/swapon -p 100 "$DEVICE"
    ;;
  stop)
    if grep -q "^${DEVICE} " /proc/swaps; then
      /sbin/swapoff "$DEVICE"
    fi
    if [ -e /sys/block/zram0/reset ]; then
      echo 1 > /sys/block/zram0/reset
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: $0 {start|stop}" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_ZRAM_SCRIPT
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_ZRAM_UNIT'
